name: Imran H. Sarkar
contribution: Served as a principal spokesperson and organizer during the 2013 Shahbag protests, coordinating public messaging and nationwide mobilization around war-crimes justice demands.
context: Shahbag/Gonojagoron Moncho mobilization in Dhaka and across Bangladesh after the February 2013 ICT verdict controversy.
impact: Helped institutionalize the protest platform's voice and sustain nationwide attention on accountability and anti-impunity demands.
highlight: Imran H. Sarkar served as a principal spokesperson and organizer of Gonojagoron Moncho during Shahbag in 2013.
seoTitle: Imran H. Sarkar: Voice of Gonojagoron Moncho
seoDescription: Explore Imran H. Sarkar's spokesperson role, Shahbag organizing, and the justice debate around Bangladesh's 2013 protests.
shortAnswer: Imran H. Sarkar was a principal spokesperson and organizer of Gonojagoron Moncho during the 2013 Shahbag protests.
